KarteaPhaseLevel

class KarteaPhaseLevel(id, phase, interval, num_obj, obj_type)[source]

Bases: ReflexiveModel

Summary model for Kartea game phase level data.

Attributes:
idint

Unique identifier for the level.

phaseKarteaPhase

The phase associated with this level.

intervalfloat

Time interval between objects (in seconds).

num_objint

Number of objects in the level.

obj_typelist[int]

Type of each object, in order (0 target, 1 obstacle), parsed from the space-separated obj_type column of the phase CSV.

PROPERTIESClassVar[list[str]], class attribute

Field names of the class, filled by initialize_reflexive.

DATA_PROPERTIESClassVar[list], class attribute

Default value of each init field (dataclasses.MISSING when the field has none), filled by initialize_reflexive.

REF_PROPERTIEStuple[str, …], class attribute

Fields written as the referenced object’s id by get_data: ("phase",).

Methods

set_data(data)

Update level data from a dictionary.

get_data()

Return level data as a list with one dictionary.

See also

KarteaPhase

Phase that owns the level.

LevelRules

Rules of a level used while the game is running.

Examples

>>> from ttea.games.kartea.model.karteaphase import KarteaPhase
>>> phase = KarteaPhase(id=1, level_list=[])
>>> level = KarteaPhaseLevel(
...     id=1, phase=phase, interval=1.5, num_obj=10,
...     obj_type=[1, 2, 3],
... )
>>> level.get_data()  
[{'id': 1, 'phase': 1, 'interval': 1.5, 'num_obj': 10,
  'obj_type': [1, 2, 3]}]
